notes.title: Patch 1.14: Buffed spells, balanced units
notes.notes:
Patch 1.14:
- General:
Two vs two unit type battles can now happen from round 6, instead of from round 8.
Three vs three unit type battles can now happen from round 12, instead of from round 14.

- Spell Balance:
Impending Doom:
Level 1 from 50 to 70 damage.
Level 2 from 80 to 120 damage
Level 3 from 150 to 250 damage.
Level 4 from 300 to 500 damage.

It will now be cast on an unit in the middle of the army.

Bless:
Duration from 7 seconds to 30 seconds.
Bonus health:
Level 1 from 50 to 150 bonus health.
Level 2 from 100 to 300 bonus health.
Level 3 from 180 to 500 bonus health.
Level 4 from 300 to 800 bonus health.

- Unit balance:
Guardian Construct from 500 points value to 300 (It is a buff, more will spawn now).
Frost Giant from 160 points value to 220.
Elder Dragon from 3000 points value to 2500.
Forest Dragon from 2000 points value to 1700.
Hypno Fish from 125 points value to 150.
Arch Angel from 160 points value to 190.
Reaper from 130 points value to 110.
		
Goblin Mechs now don’t take up so much space (a buff).
Improved yeti and wendigo attack sounds when there are a lot of them attacking at once.
Thanks to DrawingDead on youtube for feedback.

Also check out my upcoming game Mage and Monsters 2:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2481640/Mage_and_Monsters_II/

notes.title: Patch 1.13c: Fixed endless bug
notes.notes: Patch 1.13c: Fixed a bug in endless that would cause you to eventually lose and have a game over.

notes.title: Patch 1.13: Added retry to quickly play again, simulator fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.13:

- Added a retry button on game over screen, to quickly start again with the same settings.

- Added Witch to simulator.

- Fixed Dwarf Necromancer summoning zombies that would attack him in simulator.

- Fixed various food cost errors in simulator.

notes.title: Patch 1.12: Added endless loop in casual autoplay
notes.notes:
Behold Battle patch 1.12:
When playing casual mode with casual autoplay enabled in options, the game will now automatically restart once round 20 is over. So you can now have an endless loop of fighting without having to do any user input.

notes.title: Patch 1.1: New impossible achievement, many audio bug fixes
notes.notes:
Behold Battle Patch 1.1:

- Fixed various unit attack and death sounds being buggy when too many units were attacking or dying at once.

- Added steam achievement to beat the game on impossible.

- Necro rat can now appear both in small battle size and medium battle size (was only in small before).

- Game mode selection screen: changed from green highlight to arrows to make it clearer what is selected.

- Medium battle size now unlocked from the start.

notes.title: Development update and planned release month
notes.notes: Hello, Behold Battle is soon ready for release. I have added winnable spectators to the release version, and now I am mainly doing the last testing to ensure a good launch experience. Currently I expect to release Behold Battle sometime in March this year. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Patch 0.73: Pathfinding improvements, chinese language
notes.notes:
- Improved the pathfinding a bunch. The units should move a lot better now.
- Added a Chinese translation.

notes.title: Patch 0.6: Added a spell game mode
notes.notes: - Added the game mode "Combat + spells": Each army gets a spell that is cast automatically during battle. The power of the spells increases with the scale of the battles.

notes.title: Patch 0.52: Added Random vs Random in settings, fixed no army bug
notes.notes:
- You can now play Random vs Random if you enable it in the settings before starting a game.
- Hopefully fixed a bug where no army shows. Please let me know if this happens again.

notes.title: Patch 0.5a: Improved normal mode and simulator
notes.notes:
Patch 0.5a:
- The winning army continues next round is now the default mode. It now also starts with 1vs1 battles (eg. 17 Archers vs 9 Ghouls) and every 7 levels increases to 2vs2 and then 3vs3.

- Added speed up/slow down buttons and zoom in/out buttons ingame.

- Many improvements to the simulator: You can now see the food cost of each unit, and see the strength of each army you make. It also remembers the last armies you have made, and restores them after each battle.

notes.title: Patch 0.4a: Added gold betting and simulator improvements
notes.notes:
Patch 0.4a:

- Added a gold betting mode. Bet gold on who you think will win, and see how much gold you can earn after 20 rounds.

-You can now place units in simulator mode while the fight is going on.

notes.title: Demo patch 0.2a: Added reroll feature and many sound fixes
notes.notes:
- Added a reroll feature. No idea who will win? You can now reroll the random armies max 3 times during a game.

- Fixed many sound issues.

- Fixed bug with priest not being able to be on green team in simulator.

- Added a units button to the top left during battle, which enables you to pause and read info about the armies.

- Added popup explanation to casual auto play option in settings: “When enabled right or left army will automatically be chosen when playing on casual. 20 rounds will thus be played without any input required.“
